_comment: Decay-monitoring returns sources. Providers are tried in order; the first with >= min_obs observations wins. forward_ledger = frozen shadow P&L (gold standard, active once the EqCalendarTilt freeze starts 2026-08-17). weekday_returns = recent equal-weight basket returns for the discovery's weekday from the equities daily data (monitoring proxy). Weekday: Monday=0, Tuesday=1, Wednesday=2.
